claims: A new Nissan Skyline is slated for release around 2027.
The new Nissan Skyline features retro-styled design cues.
The new Nissan Skyline features a 3.0L twin-turbo V6 engine.
The new Nissan Skyline was teased in Japan.
The new Nissan Skyline is expected to come to the U.S. as a new Infiniti sport sedan.
The new Nissan Skyline effectively acts as a successor to the Infiniti Q50.
The new Nissan Skyline/Infiniti is designed to blend heritage styling from the 1960s with modern performance.
The new Nissan Skyline/Infiniti aims to sit between the Nissan Z and GT-R in terms of lineup positioning.
Reports suggest a 3.0-liter V6 twin-turbo engine producing roughly 450 horsepower for the new Nissan Skyline/Infiniti.
The new Nissan Skyline/Infiniti is expected to arrive in the United States as an Infiniti-badged sedan.
The current Skyline (V37) has been sold as the Infiniti Q50 in the U.S.
Beginning in 2002, the Skyline was exported to North America as the Infiniti G35.
The Skyline was exported to North America as the Infiniti G37.
The 13th-generation Skyline was sold in the U.S. as the Infiniti Q50 sedan.
The Infiniti Q60 is the coupe variant of the 13th-generation Skyline.
